provenance.what: one conversation read twice: from the daemon that ran it, then from a second daemon on the same isolated home after the runtime was SIGKILLed — the durable-only row
provenance.how: two isolated `lop mobile serve` runs on one redirected HOME + LOCAL_OPERATOR_CONFIG_DIR, own ephemeral ports, hosting=test/model_name=mock
provenance.redactions: paths and home omitted; the session id is throwaway

note: Nothing registered with the second daemon, so the row is durable-only: `ended` is FALSE even though the process is provably gone, and `degraded` is false by construction. `model_label` is empty on the durable row — a client must render the durable facts it has and make no liveness claim from these two fields.
